meanings.meaning: The cutting off of the foreskin of a boy or man. God gave this as a sign of His promise to Abraham and his family, and a baby boy was circumcised when he was eight days old.
A word for the Jewish people, who were circumcised, as opposed to the Gentiles, who were not. Some cards use it for a group of people who held to this rite.
A picture of a clean heart, changed inside by God's Spirit, and not only a mark on the body. It means turning away from sin.
